finishing.note: finish: 2012 bevelled hard edges, custom (hardened) normals true, 82% of faces smooth-shaded, baked atlas at 771.6 px/m from 3 CC0 scans; one UV set (1); 3 PBR PNGs (base colour, normal, ORM for 1 slots); every file under 10 MB (largest 4653306 bytes); 1 material slots (shelves_atlas); evidence turnaround.jpg and table-view.jpg rendered with Cycles on the CPU (in-context EEVEE renders: scripts/art/studio-kit/render_context.bpy), framing check passes on 5 images (min silhouette margin 0.0646 of the image, rule 0.03). Not claimed: any UE import.

pivot: base centre (x and y at the middle of the footprint, z = 0 at the floor); measured 0, 0 m; the prop stands +Y in the GLB (glTF Y-up), +Z in Blender
scale_reasoning: a four-board open steel rack, 90 x 30 cm footprint, 125 cm tall, filled: about forty cloth books, paper stacks, box files and rolled drawings. Measured 88 x 128 x 30 cm (x, up, y); the planned envelope per axis is 85-95 cm, 27-34 cm, 120-130 cm (x, y, z up).
textures: 3 PNGs: one 2048 px atlas (shelves_atlas_basecolor, _orm with R occlusion, G roughness, B metal, and a tangent-space OpenGL _normal), baked with Cycles on the CPU in scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy from layered bake-source materials (scripts/art/lib/finish.bpy): Poly Haven CC0 scans tinted to the palette, curvature edge wear, room-scale grunge, AO (also multiplied into basecolor at 0.55, as the forward-shaded UE scene has no runtime AO). One unique UV set: smart projection, islands at one texel density, hidden faces (book sides inside a row, undersides) shrunk to 0.12, 771.6 px/m on the visible surface (3.1725 m2 visible, 83% of the surface hidden). Bake seconds: {"base":11.44,"rough":9.5,"metal":5.05,"normal":14.53,"ao":76.7}. GLB embeds the atlas as quality-92 JPEG (the PNG set would put the GLB over 10 MB).

finish.bevel: angle-limited (30 degrees) bevel on every primitive's hard edges, width per part (0.5 to 3 mm), 2 segments, arc miter, clamped, hardened normals, then a weighted normal (face area, keep sharp) and smooth shading; 2012 hard edges bevelled, 1476 kept sharp by design (paper edges, spiral roll ends, small screws), 16 convex edges of 60 degrees or more left unrounded (inside other parts or at acute corners)

blender: Blender 5.2.2, scripts/art/studio-kit/build_studio.bpy (build and score), render_studio.bpy (evidence and framing check), write_manifest.mjs
